            // Act

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Garnet.common;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace Garnet.server
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Transaction manager for RESP protocol
    /// </summary>
    internal sealed class TxnManager
    {
        public enum TxnState
        {
            None,
            Started,
            Running,
            Aborted
        }

        private TxnState state;
        private int txnStartHead;
        private int operationCntTxn;
        private bool readOnly;
        private int saveKeyRecvBufferPtr;

        public TxnState State => state;
        public int TxnStartHead => txnStartHead;
        public int OperationCntTxn => operationCntTxn;
        public bool ReadOnly => readOnly;
        public int SaveKeyRecvBufferPtr => saveKeyRecvBufferPtr;

        public void Commit()
        {
            state = TxnState.Running;
        }

        public void Reset(bool abort)
        {
            if (abort)
            {
                state = TxnState.Aborted;
            }
            else
            {
                state = TxnState.None;
            }
        }

        public bool Run()
        {
            // Run the transaction
            return true;
        }

        public void GetKeysForValidation(int recvBufferPtr, out List<string> keys, out int keyCount, out bool readOnly)
        {
            // Get keys for validation
            keys = new List<string>();
            keyCount = 0;
            readOnly = false;
        }

        public void LockKeys(RespCommandInfo commandInfo)
        {
            // Lock keys for the command
        }
    }
}
